subhead: From AI governance and PoC to production. Each project is backed by numbers.

sdlc.title: AI SDLC: where each project sits in the lifecycle
sdlc.note: Solid tag = main stage. Dashed tag = secondary stage. Click a tag to open the project.

stages.name: Business Planning
stages.desc: Define use case, value, cost, and rules: is it worth it, and how to measure it.

stages.name: Model Tuning
stages.desc: Data, prompts, evaluation, and red teaming: make the model correct and safe.

stages.name: Development & Deployment
stages.desc: Select the platform, integrate systems, launch: turn the plan into a service.

stages.name: Operations & Monitoring
stages.desc: Governance, risk, and adoption: keep it running and get people to use it.

proof.label: Guardrails test set
proof.context: 6 Policies × 100 cases based on OWASP, run 3,600 times through the API.

proof.label: Platform issues found early
proof.context: 26 hands-on tests on Agatha found 12 issues: 4 blocking, 1 security.

proof.label: Platform scoring standard
proof.context: A 42-item scorecard in 9 categories to compare Agatha and Dify.

proof.label: AI Agent cost models
proof.context: Capacity, on-premises amortization, and cloud tokens for 3-year TCO / ROI.

proof.label: Launched to production
proof.context: Webai Finance: I led it from requirements and PoC to launch.

proof.label: AI projects delivered or verified
proof.context: Across a bank, a financial holding company, and a data company.

paragraphs: I am a PM and System Analyst at KGI Bank, Technology Innovation Department. I lead AI Agent PoCs, platform evaluation, cost and ROI models, and pre-launch governance.
Before this, I led the Webai Finance launch at KGI Financial Holding. At TEJ, I built a RAG customer service bot and a Multi-Agent advisory system. I am also a graduate student in Finance at NTUST.
Outside work, I enjoy photography and swimming.
